item.title: How to make a table editable in Vue
item.description: Creating editable tables allows users to modify data directly within table cells, essential for admin panels and data management interfaces. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built editable tables in countless enterprise applications. The most effective solution is to track which row is being edited and toggle between view and edit modes. This approach provides inline editing with clear save and cancel actions.
